title: Laravel 10, flagged features, and encrypted environments
content:
Jake and Michael discuss all the latest Laravel releases, tutorials, and happenings in the community.

This episode is sponsored by Honeybadger - combining error monitoring, uptime monitoring and check-in monitoring into a single, easy to use platform and making you a DevOps hero.

  • (01:25) - Laravel 9.94 released
  • (08:50) - Laravel 9.51 released
  • (12:41) - Laravel 10 is now released!
  • (26:09) - Laravel Artisan cheatsheet supports Laravel 10
  • (27:22) - Sponsor: Honeybadger
  • (28:40) - Laravel Pennant
  • (34:27) - Google reCaptcha Enterprise package for Laravel
  • (36:03) - Export Eloquent modelsl to JSON files
  • (38:33) - Encrypt environment files with Padlock
  • (41:05) - Learn how to impersonate users in your Laravel app
  • (41:50) - Testing JSON:API endpoints with PestPHP
  • (42:03) - Getting started with PHPInsights
  • Laravel Versions
